title: Delegated redline guardrails and fast-acceptance path for sales/legal exceptions
creator: Aisha Romero
description: Build a practical, auditable workflow that lets Sales and Sales Engineers accept a bounded set of contract redlines without full legal queue review. Deliverables: 1) Delegated-signature and concession matrix (by liability/indemnity/term), 2) a fast-acceptance path (sub-48h) for low-to-medium risk exceptions, 3) template language and pre-approved counters for SEs, 4) telemetry and audit trail integrated into ContractOps dashboard.
background: Enterprise deals are increasingly slowed by repetitive, low-risk redlines (e.g., escrow access window tweaks, short liability caps, non-material DPA section clarifications). Legal is overloaded with high-risk reviews and lacks a safe, documented way to delegate repeatable decisions to Sales. We need a guardrail-driven delegation model that reduces cycle time without increasing legal exposure.
scope: Define risk buckets, allowed clause edits per bucket, signature/delegation thresholds, UI for SEs in contract intake form, audit logging, and a pilot with 3 sales reps and 10 target accounts. Excludes automated contract generation or end-to-end e-sign integration in this phase.
acceptance_criteria: Delegation matrix published and signed off by Legal and Finance
SE-facing intake form built with explicit checkboxes for allowed edits
ContractOps dashboard shows audit records for every delegated approval
Pilot reduces average legal review TTR for delegated tickets from 5 days to <=48 hours
No increase in medium/high post-signature incidents attributable to delegated approvals during pilot
tasks: Work with Legal to draft delegated-signature matrix and acceptable clause language
Create SE template responses and pre-approved counters for common DPA/MSA clauses
Design intake form flows and required attestation language for SE confirmation
Add audit logging and metadata to ContractOps dashboard (contract id, approver, time, rationale)
Implement enforcement hooks: block if requested concession falls outside matrix
Run legal training and live Q&A for pilot SEs
Pilot with 3 reps across 10 deals for 4 weeks and collect metrics
Analyze pilot results and present go/no-go to Legal/Revenue leadership
risks: Delegated approvals could create downstream indemnity exposure if matrix is too permissive
SEs may misuse attestation if training is insufficient
Dashboard telemetry not capturing required evidence could break auditability
Integration delays with ContractOps backend may push pilot timeline
rollout_plan: Phase 1: Legal and Finance finalize matrix (2 weeks). Phase 2: Build intake form + audit logging + SE templates (3 weeks). Phase 3: Run 4-week pilot with 3 SEs, collect metrics. Phase 4: Post-pilot review and iterate; scale to 20 reps if no major issues.
metrics: Median legal review time for delegated tickets (days)
% delegated approvals flagged by Legal for retro-review
Post-signature incident rate attributed to delegated approvals
